name: El Granado (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes of black, white, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Granado (a bend on white and a wheel on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of El Granado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Granado arms — bend on white and wheel on yellow
cap of the crown of the arms
